title: the Palatinate Rising
author: Quentin Thackeray
blurb: Paloma Voss, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
